issue.description: After the coordinate review, inspect ADR-025, research/specs/secret-ruleset-v4.md section 5.2, and research/specs/needle-cli-contract-v1.md. Check the exact write-time standard-error line, advisory_findings type and count semantics, additive machine output, secret-rejection-v1 acknowledgments and mutation behavior, and the threat-model consequences of ambiguity or divergent implementations. issue.notes:
BR-T35 focused write-time diagnostics review (2026-10-03; current source hashes: docs/adr/025-surface-advisory-findings-and-partial-scan-coverage.md e13bda45279d2b875c9c2dce6d2bdc3e0471e91512cff22ec40487f1a0de4a33; research/specs/secret-ruleset-v4.md bad7c8102086d8128465e284b839673ceceb84b28e3ea7bf55835dfaee5ad5a9; research/specs/secret-rejection-v1.md f6aa7639a8ef1dd509b431853abf64db78d0923ef9e9d59b09e0a4e0e55df231; research/specs/needle-cli-contract-v1.md 64a4057bdec893d81e42a3f23bff86f225a302fc3b5fec18d8ab5cf414ad7233).

Compatibility disposition: ACTIONABLE REJECTION. ADR-025 Decision item 2 (docs/adr/025-surface-advisory-findings-and-partial-scan-coverage.md:38-41) requires one redacted stderr notice carrying a count, rule identifiers, and `bead doctor --scope secrets`, plus an additive machine-output count; its consequence note (lines 82-84) explicitly calls for checking the stderr contract. Ruleset-v4 section 5.2 (research/specs/secret-ruleset-v4.md:253-260) repeats the one-line/no-matched-bytes/off-mode requirements and names `secret_scan.advisory_findings`, but does not define that member's JSON type, placement on every machine-readable mutation result, whether the count is findings/rules/fingerprints or is deduplicated, or stable rule-ID ordering/literal line grammar. The section 5.1 per-field cap (lines 244-249) does not resolve aggregate count semantics. NEEDLE's actual process contract (research/specs/needle-cli-contract-v1.md:11-15) makes stderr diagnostics and valid JSON stdout compatible, and its issue-output rule (lines 57-65) permits additive fields; it does not make an unspecified field type compatible. The accepted v1 contract still requires complete pre-transaction scanning and all-or-nothing blocking rejection with no state change (research/specs/secret-rejection-v1.md:51-56), and exact-fingerprint single-finding acknowledgment with an audit record, no blanket bypass, and explicit modes (lines 58-61); none of those invariants may be weakened.

Explicit stderr assessment: PASS for channel/routing compatibility only: a successful mutation may emit a redacted advisory diagnostic on stderr without corrupting JSON stdout, changing exit status, or violating the v1 no-value rule (secret-ruleset-v4.md:255-260; needle-cli-contract-v1.md:11-15; secret-rejection-v1.md:25-35). ACTIONABLE for the exact stderr contract: the sources specify the required information but no deterministic serialization, rule-ID order, count basis, or whether “exactly one line” means one secret-scan notice versus all stderr from the invocation. It must be defined as one stable secret-scan notice record and coexist explicitly with unrelated success diagnostics; otherwise consumers can diverge while still claiming conformance.

Threat-model disposition: ACTIONABLE REJECTION. Ambiguous advisory type/count and line grammar can make one implementation report a finding while another collapses or miscounts it, causing missed agent triage, false failures, or incompatible automation. Divergent deduplication/order also makes write-time evidence non-reproducible; an implementation that exposes a list or matched coordinates could create disclosure risk even though v1 requires all diagnostics, serialization, events, and dry-run output to omit matched bytes (research/specs/secret-rejection-v1.md:23-39). The pre-transaction rejection, exact-fingerprint acknowledgment, audit, and no-mutation-on-unacknowledged-blocking semantics remain sound, but they do not repair the advisory-output ambiguity. Before v4 acceptance, define the additive member as one exact type and location, its count/deduplication scope and ordering, and a stable redacted stderr grammar including off-mode absence; otherwise divergent consumers and implementations undermine both compatibility and secret-triage safety.
